question.problem: The ratio $9:2$ is equivalent to the ratio $36:${{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
To find the ratio equivalent to $9:2$, we multiply both numbers by the same value:

$$
\begin{aligned}\,\,9 &  & : & \,\,\, & \,\,2 &  \\ \,\,↓\times \,4 &  &  &  & \,\,↓\times \,4 &  \\ \,\,36 &  & : &  & \,\boxed{} & \end{aligned}
$$

To get $36$ from $9,$ we multiply $9$ by $4.$ So, to get $\,\boxed{}\,$ from $2,$ we multiply $2$ by $4$ as well:

$$
4\times 2=8
$$

The ratio $9:2$ is equivalent to $36:8.$
